answer: The standard working week at Northwind Labs is 38 hours, normally spread over five days. [1]
Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 15:00 local time; outside these hours employees may arrange their schedule freely, provided their team agrees [2].
Overtime on a public holiday is compensated at a rate of 1.5 hours per hour worked, as stated in the employee handbook [2].
A full-time employee accrues 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year [3].
You cannot take unused vacation days into the next year. ([3])
A medical certificate is required from the third consecutive day of sickness [3].
Employees may work remotely for up to three days per week after completing their probation period [1].
Yes, you can work from another country for a maximum of 20 working days per calendar year [2].

Each employee receives an annual learning budget of 1,500 euros that can be spent on courses, certifications, conference tickets and technical books [1].
Pay raises take effect after the completion of the probation period for employees. [2]
After probation, the notice period is one month, unless the employment contract states otherwise [1].
Unused vacation days are paid out with the final salary when leaving the company [2].
Business travel expenses are reimbursed when they are submitted through the finance portal within 30 days of the trip, and receipts are mandatory for any single expense above 25 euros [1].
Passwords for company accounts must contain at least 14 characters [1].

Severity 1 incidents are the most severe level, covering confirmed breaches of Restricted data or ransomware [1].
Production databases are backed up every six hours [1].

If you click a simulated phishing link, you're assigned a short follow-up module instead of being disciplined [2].
The CloudBox S2 has a limited hardware warranty of three years from the date of purchase [1].
The hard drives that come in the CloudBox S2 are covered by the warranty for two years [1].
No, data stored on the device is never covered by the warranty, and Northwind Devices is not responsible for lost data or data recovery [1].
No, the warranty does not cover damage caused by spills such as coffee. ([4])
You have 30 days to return a CloudBox S2 purchased directly from the Northwind Devices online store for a full refund [4].
Customers pay return shipping unless the device is faulty. [1]
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 14 days after the returned device has been inspected [1].

To start a warranty claim for a broken unit, open a return merchandise authorisation request in the support portal [1]. Support will run a remote diagnosis with the customer, and if the fault is confirmed, a prepaid shipping label will be emailed within two working days [1].

Yes, for the first year of the warranty, an advance replacement service is available where the replacement is shipped first, and the customer returns the faulty unit within 14 days in the same packaging [1].
If you keep the faulty unit after receiving an advance replacement, you must pay a fee of 120 euros. [5]
The CloudBox S2 firmware receives security updates for at least five years after the last sale, and feature updates for at least three years [2].
Firmware updates for the CloudBox S2 are installed automatically between 02:00 and 05:00 local time unless automatic updates are switched off in the settings [2].
Installing custom firmware voids the software support but does not, by itself, void the hardware warranty. [3]
The CloudBox Care plan costs 39 euros per year. [1]

Errors must last at least five consecutive minutes to count as downtime [2].

No, service credits are not paid out as cash refunds. Instead, they are applied to the next invoice [1].

The first response time for urgent tickets on Enterprise subscriptions is 15 minutes, with the first response targeting available around the clock [1].
You can escalate an unresolved outage to an engineering manager within four hours if it's a Priority 1 issue [1].
Planned maintenance takes place on Sundays between 01:00 and 05:00 UTC, with customers notified at least seven days in advance [1].
Customers are notified at least seven days in advance through the status page and by email. [1]
After a subscription ends, data remains available for export for 30 days and is then permanently deleted within a further 30 days [1].
No, the uptime guarantees do not apply to beta features [1].
Root cause analysis reports are published within five business days after every Priority 1 incident [2].
Employees are granted 10 weeks of parental leave [1].

To reset the CloudBox S2 to factory settings, you must access the CloudBox app or web interface and navigate to the settings menu. From there, select the option to perform a factory reset. This process will erase all data on the device and restore it to its original state. Please note that this action cannot be undone, and it is recommended to back up any important data before proceeding. ([1])
